images.title: A long row of closed lockers
images.purpose: Sets up the puzzle: a row of identical closed lockers numbered from 1 to 100, and the question of which stay open.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One long horizontal row of tall locker doors across the middle, with a short gap of three dots standing for the lockers in between.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 5 tall rectangular locker doors of equal size in one horizontal row, all drawn closed, filled teal (#0072B2) with dark outlines and a small round grey (#6B7280) handle on each. From left: three doors numbered 1, 2 and 3 on small white plates near their tops, then a gap holding exactly three dark dots in a row, then two doors numbered 99 and 100. Above the row, centred, the question which stay open? in dark text with the question mark in reddish purple (#CC79A7). No people, no treasure, nothing else in the frame.
